'''August 2000 Augusta tournament (26 August)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Book Exchange, Augusta, GA on 26 August 2000. [[Arthur Rhodes]] won it. It is known from Arthur Rhodes's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1163">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-26-augusta-georgia-8-26-00d1163/ augusta-georgia-8-26-00], DeckTech (Arthur "arthur" Rhodes, 26 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-26-augusta-georgia-8-26-00d1163/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 26 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Book Exchange, Augusta, GA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Arthur Rhodes]]
